subject: dxf: support modify concurrency/task-specific-param for later subtask at task executor part (#58144)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent with focus on DDL add-index/backfill and its DXF integration. The change updates task-executor construction to a Param-based API, adds runtime-updatable step resources (SetResource) + task-meta change hook (TaskMetaModified), and switches DDL backfill step executors to derive runtime concurrency from StepResource.CPU capacity rather than Subtask.Concurrency. No Blocker/High correctness, consistency, concurrency, or DDL metadata/state-machine issues found in the touched DDL/backfill paths under the intended invariants (task concurrency is positive and bounded by node CPU).
